title.narrative: Promoting Good Governance - Support to Civil Society and Bhutanese Parliament engagement with Civil Society Organisations (CSOs)

description.narrative: The global objective of this direct award is to enhance democratisation and sustainable development of Bhutan.The specific objectives of this direct award are to: i. create an enabling environment for Civil Society as change agents and ii. to enhance engagement of civil society with Parliament.
